content: Fast Green FCF, also known as Food Green 3 or FD&C Green No. 1 (42053), is a synthetic sea-green triarylmethane dye used in various applications. Its E number is E143. This dye is often recommended as a substitute for Light Green SF Yellowish in Masson's trichrome staining due to its more vivid coloration and greater resistance to fading. In histological applications, Fast Green FCF is employed as a quantitative stain for histones at an alkaline pH following the acid extraction of DNA. Additionally, it is utilized as a protein stain in electrophoresis techniques. The dye exhibits a maximum absorption wavelength at 625 nm. Fast Green FCF is poorly absorbed by the intestines when ingested. Its use as a food dye is prohibited in the European Union and several other countries. However, it can be used in specific food products such as tinned green peas, other vegetables, jellies, sauces, fish, desserts, and dry bakery mixes, with a maximum allowable concentration of 100 mg/kg. The risk phrases associated with Fast Green FCF are R36 (irritating to eyes), R37 (irritating to the respiratory system), and R38 (irritating to the skin).
